content: Ka oonow mu pepetugase, mu susumudu tunaka'oedyukudu ka Antioch mee naneadu-kwi nonobe-ga'yoo. Umu-matu nanesootuhibu numu tunedyooedu, mu Barnabas-no Paul umu-no.
Ka gi tukapana mu nanesootuha'e soo Te Naa Besa Pooha mu yadoo'e, “Nu ka Barnabas noko Paul netutzea, noko numu nu-kwitu mu tunedyooe tuunguna. Umuoo sakwa mu taya.”
Mu tunaka'oedyukudu gi tukapana ka Paul noko Barnabas-ma pooha matuguse, mu nanesootuhikute yise mana mu taya.
Soo Te Naa Besa Pooha ka Barnabas noko Paul tayase, umu ka Seleucia Cyrene mee naneadu-kwi pepetuga. Onona umu natzemangeka
ka Salamis mee naneadu-kwitoo. Ka oe pepetugase, mu Jew numu nanesootuhi nobe-kwi pepetuooga, mu Jew numu ka Te Naa unnena tuukwe. John Mark ka mu Paul noko Barnabas tummatza'e.
Umu yise saa'a ka Paphos mee naneadu-kwi petugonnoga. Oosoo ka Salamis mee naneadu tubewabe oo'enakwa. Soo suta'yoo Jew numu poohadu Bar-Jesus mee naneadu o numu-no.
Soo mu wakwawa'a moohedu Sergius Paulus mee nane'a, oosoo mu wakwawa'a moohedu besa tusooyugwedu, mu Barnabas noko Paul ka Te Naa-witu tutuubenga.
Soo Bar-Jesus ka Sergius Paulus meeoo netamma, “Gi ka Paul noko Barnabas naka'oedyukupana.”
Ka Te Naa God Besa Pooha punagakoo oo poonnese, meeoo unakwe.
“U mu numu gi toge neyugwedu. U ka sutakoo nunu'u-kwa'ne'yoo. U ka Te Naa tumoo'oona mu numu ka gi besow podo ta'ya.
Soo suda u manena u-matoosoo kodyudooa gi u manena petzabena. U gi tubootabue manekwu ka suda u manena gi ma'wuna.” Yabesoo gi tubootabue manise, numu pumme tsakakwudu too'e kwate.
Soo Sergius Paulus ka Bar-Jesus gi tubootabuedu poonne oosoo yise ka Te Pabe'e-witu naka'oedyukute yise ka Te Naa unnepu nesookwuga'e.
Soo Paul tu pupua'amu-no ka Paphas-wi'yoona baa-koobakwi natzemangeka ka Perga mee naneadu-kwi pepetuga
. Soo John Mark yise mu ma'wukase ka Jerusalem-witoo kodyuka, pummesoo nobe-kwitoo.
Umu Paul-no Barnabas ka Perga mee naneadu-too memease, ka Antioch mee naneadu-kwi pepetuga ka teepu Pisidia-kooba. Ka te nanesootuhi tabebano'o umu ka mu Jew numu nanesootuhi nobe-kwitoo memea.
Mu Jew nanesootuhidu nemadugudu ka Te Naa God unnena neamakwuse meeoo mu netamma, “E nanumu, manatu haa'a ha'yoosoo unnekwe?”
Soo Paul oo wunuse mee mu netamma, “E nanumu-no mu tooe haga tooe Te Naa God naka'oedyukudu e nakapunne.

Soo Te Naa God, pu-matoo tamme Jew numu nanesootuhina, ka mu te nanamooatupu netutsease, ka mu nanesootuhikuse ewa mu mayugwe ka Egypt-wi'yoona, ka mu wakwawa'a-wa'nekoo. Soo Te Naa yise unu pooha-ga'yoo ka Egypt-wikoo mu bikase,
mu mabetsea ewa (40) tomoka ka teepu gi numu tumasuana naa-kwi.
Oosoosoo tuwow (7) natakwatsukwuoo-baatoo numu kadoo mayukwe ka Canaan mee naneadu teepu-kooba yise ka te nanamoo'atupu ookow teepu mu tzapokaku.
Unu ewa (450) tomoka'a oosoo ka mu nana'akwedu-matu unu pooha-gakoo netutzease. O'no soo numu moohedu Samuel mee naneadu ka Te Naa God yadooawabe mane.
Umu yise pukobena katudu nekwina, soo Te Naa ka Saul mee naneadu netutsea
. Ewa (40) tomoka oosoo ka mu numu-kobena katuna.
O'no yise soo Te Naa oo nabatsakuse ka David yise netutsea ka numu-kobenatoo. Soo Te Naa God mee unakwe,

content.text: ‘Soo David, Jesse dooa, oosoo nana e sookwi-kwa'ne'yoo. Ooosapa besa e nakabetseadu.’

content: Soo Te Naa God ka Te Pabe'e Jesus tamme Jew numu magwetzoidu matabuepu-ga'yoo. Soo Te Pabe'e Jesus David-matu mee'e soo Te Naa God te tuukwepu-ga'yoo.

Ka Te Pabe'e Jesus gisoo Te Naa unnepu mu numu tuukwe petu, soo John mee naneadu meeoo mu numu tuukwe'e, ‘No'yoona mu Jew numu sakwa ka suda tu manena ma'wuse baa-wi namatzakase ka Te Naa God besa podo mea,’ mee.
Soo John ka numu tu tunedyooena mamakwuse meeoo unakwe, ‘Nu Te Pabe'e mee haa'a mu e sooyugwe? Gi nu. Soo Te Tubetse Pabe'e saa'a petukwu. Nu gi oo-wa'ne'yoo. Oosoo e ooonakwa pooha-ga'yoo.’
E nanumu, mu Abraham dooamu-matu yise mu susumudu numu Te Naa meeoo te tuukwe, ‘Nu mu magwetzoikwu.’

Mu numu Jerusalem-wi nonobe-ga'yoo ka mu pumme moohedu-no tooe nono'atsa ka Te Naa unnepu naka, ka oo tubona naneayakwe, pana gi yise ka Jesus Te Pabe'e sopedakwatoo. Gi oo nakasopedakwatoo ka Te Naa o'nosoo Te Pabe'e-witu oo waha. Umu ka Te Naa unnena gi naka'oedyuku pana oo mayoho.
Umu gi hanotusoo suda na'unnedu ka Te Pabe'e-witu waha-wa'ne'yoo pana ka Pilate ooka batsa tuungu.
O'nosoo ka Te Naa tuukwewabe meeoo tubopu umu ka Te Pabe'e Jesus batsakwu. Umu yise tooesoo oo manakwe. Oosoo ka ya'ese, ka sunngabe namadabue-ma'yoona natzakwekuse, nakoo.
Soo Te Naa oo matusootabuesoo.
Ewa tabeba-wi oosoo umu-no Galilee-wi'yoona kemmadu natzapoonnekuyakwe. Umuoo naana mu numu oetuooo tuukwe.
Meno'o numme Barnabas-no yow petu mu tuukwe ka Te Naa o'nosoo unnepu ka Te Naa ka Te Pabe'e Jesus tamme magwetzoi-kwitu.
Meno'o toge oo-toogoosoo Te Naa unnepu manakwe. O'nosoo David meeoo tubope-ga'yoo ka penakwa hoobeabe-kwi meeoo unakwe Te Pabe'e witu,

content.text: ‘Soo Te Naa meeoo unakwe, “U e dooa. Nu u tubetse Naa. Nu meno'o mu numu tuukwe'e.” ’

content: Soo Te Naa meeoo unakwe,

content.text: ‘Nu besa u tummatzikoo ka David e tuukwe-kwa'nesoo.’

content: Ka kumma'akoosoo David hoobea tubo-kwi tuwazoo meeoo,

content.text: ‘U gi ka u tunetutzeana tookoo peheku-wa'ne'yoo.’

content: Soo David ka Te Pabe'e-witu meeoo tubo'o gi puusoo nakwitu. Soo David ka Te Naa pumme netammatoo manese, ya'e. Ka oo nakoose oo tookoo mooasoo pehewunu.
Pana soo Te Pabe'e tookoo gi pehe. Te Naasoo oo matuusootabuesesoo.
E nanumu e naka, soo Te Pabe'e Jesus tamme-koobatoo nabatsase, soo Te Naa ka te tuma'emukwana sumu'wase te sootuhikwu.

Ka te tunaka'oedyukute soo Te Naa te tuma'emukwana sumu'wa. Tamme ka te nanamooatupuna manena sukwe mayohona, ka Moses tamme tuukwe-kwa'ne. Soo Te Naa gi te tuma'emukwana sumu'wa tamme ka Te Pabe'e-wi gi tunaka'oedyukuna.
Umu meeoo tubo'o Te Naa meeoo unakwe,

content.text: ‘E nakapunne. Mu ka gi sootunaka'oedyukuna, mu kadoo'oo namayugwekwu. Ka tooesoo u gwetzoa'e, nu u tummatzikwu. Tooe numu e tuukwe sapa mu gi oo naka'oedyuku-wa'ne'yoo.’

content: Mu sakwa oo naka'oedyuku, o'no gi mu kadoo'oo namayugwekwu ka mu o'nosoo Te Naa te tuukwe-kwa'ne.”
Mu Paul noko Barnabas nanesootuhi nobe-kwi'yoona umu kukuowse umu meeoo mu netamma, “Ka penakwa nanesootuhikwuse, ka Te Naa unnena saa'a ne tuukwesoo.”
Ewa'yoo mu Jew numu-no mu wakwawa'a mu Jew-kwa'ne nanesootuhi tabuadu ka Paul noko Barnabas-no mea. Paul-no Barnabas mu yadooena meeoo mu netamma, “Mu sakwa Te Naa besa podo ooosapa mea.”
Ka penakwa nanesootuhi tabenoo ewa'yoo mu numu ka Antioch-wi sumu ka Te Naa unnena nakakwuse.
Umu Jew numu moohedu unu suta'a ka ewow numu gi Jew numu pana oetoo kemma ka Paul nakana. Umuoo moohedu ka Paul noko Barnabas unnena netumoo'oo.

Mu Paul-no Barnabas gi mu Jew numu unne-ma suina meeoo unakwe, “Mu ka Te Naa unnena mooe naka. Mu muusoo gi oo naka'oedyukuna mu yise gi nasootuha'e. Numme yise meno'o ka mu wakwawa'a Te Naa unnepu-witu tuukwekwu.
Ka o'nosoo numu meeoo tuukwedu ka Te Naa unnena po tuguse te tuukwe'e.

content.text: ‘U sakwa no'oko enatu tooe mu wakwawa'a nu-kwitu tuukwe. O'no mu e nakasopedakwadoo yise namagwetzoikwu,’

content: mee soo Te Naa.”
Mu wakwawa'a oo nakase, besa sokwamana meeoo unakwe, “Soo Te Naa unnepu unu besa'yoo.” No'yoona umu Te Naa tunetutzeana tunaka'oedyukute.
Soo Te Naa unnena yise tooe hanotu tooe yaa teepu-koobatu numu oo naka.

Mu Jew numu moohedu, mu momoko'ne ka mu Jew numu-kwa'ne nanesootuhidu, mu numu moohedu ka mu Paul noko Barnabas tumoo'oose, o'no yise umu ka Antioch-wi'yoona memea. Mu Paul-no Barnabas yise ka Antioch kooseba tu kuku-makoo tata'nese, mu numu tzapoonnekuna ka how suta'yoo umu. Ka Antioch-witu umu tunaka'oedyukudu besa sokwama ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-tooha tunaka'oedyukuna. Mu Paul-no Barnabas yise ka Iconium mee naneadu-wi pepetuga.
